gloss: have a good New Year (said before the year ends)

definitions.gloss: have a good New Year (parting greeting in the last days of December)
definitions.explanation: Short for {良|よ}いお{年|とし}をお{迎|むか}えください, 'may you greet a good new year.' Said in the last days of December when parting from someone you will not see again until after January 1; from New Year's Day onward the greeting changes to {明|あ}けましておめでとうございます.

examples.english: Well then, have a good New Year.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦お{世話|せわ}になりました→お世話になりました：30848_osewaninarimashita⟧。{良|よ}いお{年|とし}を」「{良|よ}いお{年|とし}を」
examples.english: 'Thank you for everything this year. Have a good New Year.' 'You too.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧{三十日|さんじゅうにち}、⟦{仕事|しごと}{納|おさ}め→仕事納め：16213_shigotoosame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧「{良|よ}いお{年|とし}を」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}い{合|あ}って→言い合う：21474_iiau⟧⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: On December 30, the last working day of the year, my colleagues and I parted with wishes for a good New Year.

notes:
USAGE:
- Used from about the middle of December until December 31, as a goodbye
- The reply is the same phrase, or {良|よ}いお{年|とし}を⟦お{迎|むか}え→お迎え：27645_omukae⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧
- Once the year has turned, say ⟦{明|あ}けましておめでとうございます→明けましておめでとうございます：30851_akemashiteomedetougozaimasu⟧ instead

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {良|よ}いお{年|とし}を⟦お{迎|むか}え→お迎え：27645_omukae⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: the full, polite form
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦お{世話|せわ}になりました→お世話になりました：30848_osewaninarimashita⟧。{良|よ}いお{年|とし}を: the usual year-end farewell to colleagues and clients

WRITING:
Also written よいお⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{明|あ}けましておめでとうございます→明けましておめでとうございます：30851_akemashiteomedetougozaimasu⟧: happy New Year (from January 1)
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧: year end
